source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #170 (Polar Bear, Pony, Priest, Priest Acolyte, Pseudodragon, Pteranodon, Purple Worm, Quasit, Rakshasa, Rat, Raven and Red Dragon Wyrmling; PDF pages 316–318 and 359) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action and bonus action entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. A hit printed without dice keeps explicit zero dice. The Rakshasa's conditional vulnerability is retained as its own note. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.text: Swallow. Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm’s turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

monsters.vulnerability_note: Piercing damage from weapons wielded by creatures under the effect of a Bless spell

traits.name: Greater Magic Resistance
traits.text: Greater Magic Resistance. The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa’s permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

traits.text: Fiendish Restoration. If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
